title: Pro-etale ring identity comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the canonical inverse-image functor and its adjunction [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define the canonical ring identity comparison $c_{X,R}:(\mathrm{id}_X)^{-1}R\xrightarrow{\sim}R$ as follows: take the inverse of the canonical direct-image identity isomorphism $(\mathrm{id}_X)_*\simeq\mathrm{id}$ induced by $V\times_X X\simeq V$ on site objects; apply the adjoint conjugation equivalence from the identity adjunction to $(\mathrm{id}_X)^{-1}\dashv(\mathrm{id}_X)_*$; and evaluate the resulting inverse-image identity isomorphism at $R$. Thus this is the comparison fixed by the adjunction unit and the projection-preserving identity of site base change, with no freely chosen ring automorphism.
